dedupe_keys.name: open transit data delhi static and real time bus data

description: Open Transit Data is the portal through which the Department of Transport of the Government of the National Capital Territory of Delhi, with IIIT-Delhi, publishes static and dynamic real-time transit datasets for businesses, third-party developers, researchers and the public, to encourage collaboration on inclusive transport solutions. Use of the datasets constitutes acceptance of the portal's terms and conditions. Coverage: Delhi public buses. Format and access: static and real-time feeds through the portal. Licence and cost: free under the Open Transit Data terms. Caveats: the landing page gives little technical detail, so formats and update rates must be checked in the portal. It supports network flow and capacity planning studies of Delhi's bus network, including reliability analysis. It relates to the GTFS specification and the Bus Observatory archive in the catalogue.
